mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MATCHES m USING (SELECT #{matchId} AS MATCH_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (m.MATCH_ID = s.MATCH_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET m.MATCH_DATE = #{matchDate}, m.HOME_SCORE = #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, m.AWAY_SCORE = #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, m.STATUS = #{status}, m.ENDED_AT = #{endedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{matchDate}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{status}, #{notice, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{endedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES ORDER BY MATCH_DATE ASC

SELECT MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES WHERE MATCH_DATE >= #{startDate} AND MATCH_DATE <= #{endDate} ORDER BY MATCH_DATE ASC

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, m.STATUS FROM MATCHES m JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE m.MATCH_DATE >= #{fromDate} AND m.STATUS IN ('SCHEDULED', 'TIMED')
AND (m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{teamId} OR m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{teamId})
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC, m.MATCH_ID ASC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS FROM MATCHES m JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE m.STATUS = 'FINISHED'
AND (m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{teamId} OR m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{teamId})
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC, m.MATCH_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS FROM MATCHES m JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE m.STATUS = 'FINISHED' AND ((m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{firstTeamId} AND m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{secondTeamId}) OR (m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{secondTeamId} AND m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{firstTeamId})) ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC, m.MATCH_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(h.TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.TEAM_NAME) AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, COALESCE(a.TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.TEAM_NAME) AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS FROM MATCHES m JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID WHERE m.STATUS = 'FINISHED' AND m.HOME_SCORE = #{homeScore} AND m.AWAY_SCORE = #{awayScore}
AND (m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{teamId} OR m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{teamId})
AND (m.HOME_TEAM_ID = #{opponentTeamId} OR m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = #{opponentTeamId})
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC, m.MATCH_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT MATCH_ID, MATCH_DATE, HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, STATUS, NOTICE, ENDED_AT FROM MATCHES WHERE MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCH_EVENTS ( MATCH_ID, TEAM_ID, EVENT_TIME, EVENT_TYPE, PLAYER_ID, ASSIST_PLAYER_ID ) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{teamId}, #{eventTime}, #{eventType}, #{playerId}, #{assistPlayerId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT me.EVENT_ID, me.MATCH_ID, me.TEAM_ID, me.EVENT_TIME, me.EVENT_TYPE, et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, me.PLAYER_ID, COALESCE(p.NAME_KOR, p.NAME) AS PLAYER_NAME, me.ASSIST_PLAYER_ID, COALESCE(ap.NAME_KOR, ap.NAME) AS ASSIST_PLAYER_NAME FROM MATCH_EVENTS me JOIN EVENT_TYPE et ON et.EVENT_TYPE_CODE = me.EVENT_TYPE JOIN PLAYERS p ON p.PLAYER_ID = me.PLAYER_ID LEFT JOIN PLAYERS ap ON ap.PLAYER_ID = me.ASSIST_PLAYER_ID WHERE me.MATCH_ID = #{matchId} ORDER BY me.EVENT_TIME ASC, me.EVENT_ID ASC
